name: Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size / Monotonic Minimum Teaching Set Size
proof: For each subfamily, the projected quantity includes its full-domain projection and is therefore at least its unprojected quantity.  Maximizing over subfamilies preserves the inequality.
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n-1$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
